books.title: Free Food for Millionaires
books.author: Min Jin Lee
books.synopsis: Casey Han, a Korean American Princeton graduate raised in Queens, struggles to find her footing in 1990s Manhattan among wealthy friends, Wall Street ambition, immigrant family duty, and a fraught love life. The novel follows her and the people around her across New York's Korean church and finance worlds.
